posts.name: BenjaminTodd
posts.cooked:
Hi All,
Some help with a combo I hadn't had before.  

Ambuscade's traps start with:

Whenever this card is face-up on the top of the villain deck...

Visonary's Precognition card reads:

Reveal the top 3 cards of the villain deck.
Put 1 on top of the villian deck and 2 on the bottom of the villian deck

Three questions:
1. Does the trap detonate when it's revealed?  I seems like it would given the text.
2. Is it considered one of the three cards for Precognition?  
3. If so (and didn't detonate), can it be moved?

Thanks,
Ben

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
Technically, the trap isn’t revealed. After a card above it is revealed, the trap is on the top of the deck and explodes. After it triggers, you keep revealing cards, since the trap wasn’t revealed, it doesn’t count as one of the revealed cards.

EDIT: Just realized that if the trap kills Visionary, we have another case of revealed cards in limbo.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
If Visionary is incapacitated by the trap the revealed cards should go back to the deck in the order they came off the top.

I would say it works this way because the action fails at the reveal stage, which would make it similar to RC Wraith trying to play a revealed environment card when Foam Grenades is active, which in the app returns the revealed card to the top of the environment deck.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
There is indeed a bug where villain cards can get into "revealed limbo" if the responsible party is knocked out while the reveal is in progress.

So far I've identified the following, which will be fixed in the next version:

  • Precognition
  • Infrared Eyepiece
  • The Super Scientific Tachyon
  • Tony Taurus (this one is an exercise for the reader)
